2608.03917.title: Implementing Causal Perception: Competing SCMs and Situated Fairness
2608.03917.paper_summary: Causal perception occurs when agents with competing Structural Causal Models (SCMs) of the same system infer different probability distributions, including the hypothetical distributions implied by each agent's SCM under the same set of interventions. It shapes how agents reason about the system and how they perceive its fairness. Causal perception is a promising probabilistic framework, but it has remained purely theoretical. This work provides the first implementation of the causal perception framework of Álvarez and Ruggieri (2025). We operationalize structural (agents disagree on the causal graph) and parametrical (agents agree on the causal graph but disagree on its weights) causal perception. We design algorithms for computing interventional and counterfactual distributions and propose suitable distance measures to quantify the disagreement. Using the German Credit dataset, we illustrate how causal perception affects accuracy and fairness in a multi-expert decision setting. We show that the perception verdict is sensitive to the choice of distance metric and threshold. We also show that causal perception changes fairness assessments and threshold-based decisions. Bias proves situated with respect to the agent's SCM, demonstrating that competing worldviews in fairness problems cannot be ignored.
2608.03917.paper_summary_zh: 因果感知發生在擁有競爭性結構因果模型（SCMs）的代理人對同一系統推斷出不同的概率分布時，包括每個代理人在相同干預下其SCM所暗示的假設分布。<lb/>它塑造了代理人如何推理系統以及他們如何感知其公平性。<lb/>因果感知是一個有前景的概率框架，但它仍然純粹是理論性的。<lb/>本研究提供了Álvarez和Ruggieri（2025）因果感知框架的首次實現。<lb/>我們將結構性（代理人對因果圖存在分歧）和參數性（代理人對因果圖達成一致但對其權重存在分歧）因果感知具體化。<lb/>我們設計了計算干預和反事實分布的算法，並提出了合適的距離度量來量化分歧。<lb/>使用德國信用數據集，我們說明了因果感知如何影響多專家決策環境中的準確性和公平性。<lb/>我們展示了感知判決對距離度量和閾值的選擇是敏感的。<lb/>我們還展示了因果感知如何改變公平性評估和基於閾值的決策。<lb/>偏見證明是相對於代理人的SCM而存在，顯示在公平性問題中競爭的世界觀不能被忽視。
